item.title: Show HN: Lilo – a lightweight Markdown notes app built with Rust and egui
item.summary: I’m building Lilo, a desktop Markdown notes/PKM app with wiki links, backlinks, search and a knowledge graph. The latest release adds Daily Notes, Quick Capture, templates, a Command Palette and structured search. Notes stay as regular Markdown files. Windows + Linux.
